missing_information_behavior: If any required context is unknown, do not issue a positive recommendation; request clarification or professional review.
safety_exclusions: Do not advise stopping prescribed therapy independently; tell user to disclose biotin dose and timing to clinician/laboratory.
professional_escalation_conditions: Urgent cardiac or endocrine testing, abnormal results inconsistent with clinical picture, or high-dose biotin use.
population_and_context: Users taking biotin who undergo laboratory testing susceptible to biotin interference.
dose_constraints: No dose; lab-specific washout guidance must come from the laboratory/clinician.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Biotin fact sheet and FDA safety communications; interference varies by assay and dose. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
